title: 1st Cavalry Division experiments with digital maintenance capabilities | Rune Technologies News
summary: The 1st Cavalry Division tested TyrOS, a Rune-developed digital maintenance application, to streamline preventive maintenance checks by replacing paper technical manuals with tablet-based documentation.
body_markdown:
U.S. Army covered Rune Technologies by Staff Sgt. Zelika Stewart in a piece titled “1st Cavalry Division experiments with digital maintenance capabilities.” The 1st Cavalry Division tested TyrOS, a Rune-developed digital maintenance application, to streamline preventive maintenance checks by replacing paper technical manuals with tablet-based documentation.


Read the full article[here](https://www.army.mil/article/295148/1st_cavalry_division_experiments_with_digital_maintenance_capabilities) .
